title: Bulk Comments Generator, Access Key, AI Symbol Input, Live List Edit/Delete, Music Play Button

requirements.summary: Add Access Key Management section to Admin > Settings with current key display (masked/show toggle), custom key input, Save Key button, and Regenerate button that creates random alphanumeric keys
acceptanceCriteria: Current key is shown masked; a toggle reveals/hides the full key
Admin can type a custom key and save it via the backend mutation
Regenerate button creates a new random key and persists it
Success/error feedback is shown after save

file_operations.description: Add useAccessKey query hook to fetch the current access key via backend.getAccessKey(), and add useSetAccessKey mutation hook that calls backend.setAccessKey(key: string) with success/error callbacks and query invalidation

Add Access Key Management section above existing music settings. Include: (1) current key display with mask/unmask toggle button, (2) text input for entering a new custom key, (3) Save Key button that calls the setAccessKey mutation, (4) Regenerate button that generates a random 16-character alphanumeric key and saves it, and (5) success/error toast notifications using the existing UI patterns

requirements.summary: Replace existing Comment Generator in User View with Bulk Comments Generator featuring App/Event dropdown, Comment List dropdown filtered by selected app, quantity selector (5/10/20/50), Access Key input, and Generate button with backend key validation
acceptanceCriteria: App dropdown and Comment List dropdown are populated from backend data
Quantity selector offers exactly 5, 10, 20, 50 options
Entering a wrong access key shows 'Invalid access key' and does not generate
Entering the correct key generates the selected number of comments
Each generated comment has the list suffix appended if present
A Copy All button copies all generated comments to clipboard
Skeleton loaders shown while backend data is fetching

file_operations.description: Replace the existing single-comment generator section with a Bulk Comments Generator. Add: (1) App/Event dropdown populated from useAppsEvents query, (2) Comment List dropdown filtered by selected app using useCommentLists query, (3) quantity selector with radio buttons or select for 5, 10, 20, 50, (4) Access Key password input field, (5) Generate button that validates the entered key against backend.getAccessKey() before generation, (6) scrollable output area displaying all generated comments with each comment showing the list's suffix appended, and (7) Copy All button using navigator.clipboard API. Show validation error toast 'Invalid access key' when keys don't match. Use skeleton loaders during data fetch

Extend the hook to support bulk generation mode: add a generateBulk function that accepts quantity, listId, and suffix parameters, randomly samples from the selected list's templates quantity times (with replacement), appends the suffix to each generated comment, and returns an array of generated comments. Remove or make optional the localStorage single-use tracking for bulk mode

requirements.summary: Add Manual Symbol input field labeled 'Append Symbol' to Admin > AI Templates that automatically appends the entered symbol to every generated template in the output list
acceptanceCriteria: A text input labeled 'Append Symbol' is visible in the AI Templates generation controls
All generated template suggestions have the entered symbol appended at the end
If the symbol field is empty, generated templates are unchanged
When templates are saved to a comment list, the symbol-appended version is saved

file_operations.description: Add a text input field labeled 'Append Symbol' above or beside the existing generation controls (tone/category/length). Store the symbol value in component state. When templates are generated via the templateGenerator utility, map over the results and append the symbol (if non-empty) to the end of each template string before displaying them in the output list. Ensure that when selected templates are saved to a comment list, the symbol-appended versions are persisted

requirements.summary: Add Edit (rename) and Delete buttons to each app/event entry row in Admin > Live List with inline editing and confirmation dialog
acceptanceCriteria: Each app/event row in Admin > Live List shows an Edit and a Delete button
Edit opens an inline editable input; saving calls the backend rename method and refreshes the list
Delete shows a confirmation dialog; confirming calls deleteAppEvent and removes the entry from the UI
Username counts update correctly after deletion

file_operations.description: Add useRenameAppEvent mutation hook that calls backend.renameAppEvent(id, newName) and invalidates the apps/events query on success. Add useDeleteAppEvent mutation hook that calls backend.deleteAppEvent(id) and invalidates the apps/events query on success

Add Edit and Delete buttons to each app/event row. For Edit: toggle to inline input mode showing the current name, provide Save/Cancel buttons, call renameAppEvent mutation on save and refresh the list. For Delete: show a confirmation dialog (using shadcn/ui AlertDialog component) with message 'This will delete the app/event and all associated usernames. Continue?', call deleteAppEvent mutation on confirm, and remove the entry from the UI with success feedback

requirements.summary: Add fixed play/pause music button in top-right corner visible to all users, showing play icon when paused and pause icon when playing, controlling background music via existing useBackgroundMusic hook
acceptanceCriteria: A play/pause button is fixed in the top-right corner and visible on all tabs
Button shows play icon when paused, pause icon when playing
Clicking toggles the background music playback via the existing useBackgroundMusic hook
When no music track is uploaded, the button is disabled and shows a 'No music uploaded' tooltip
Button does not overlap critical header controls on mobile

file_operations.description: Add a fixed-position music play/pause button in the top-right corner of the header (or as a floating button overlaying the viewport). Use the existing useBackgroundMusic hook to access isPlaying state and toggle function. Show a play icon (from lucide-react or shadcn/ui icons) when paused, pause icon when playing. Query backend settings via useQueries to check if a music file is uploaded; if not, disable the button and show a tooltip 'No music uploaded' (using shadcn/ui Tooltip component). Ensure the button is visible and accessible on all tabs and does not overlap the admin badge or countdown timer on mobile viewports
